column4: (7) The Minister may, for reasons assigned, remove the

column3: Chairman or the Working Director of the Board.

column4: (8) If the Chairman or the Working Director, by reason of

column3: illness, infirmity or absence from Sri Lanka, is temporarily
unable to perform the duties of his office, the Minister may
nominate another member of the Board to act in his place.

column4: (9) The Chairman or the Working Director may, at any

column3: time  resign  from  office  of  the  Chairman  or  the  Working
Director by a letter addressed to the Minister. Such resignation
shall take effect upon it being accepted by the Minister in
writing.

column4: (10) Subject to the provisions of subsections (2) and (3),

column3: the term of office of the Chairman and the Working Director
shall be three years. The Chairman and the Working Director
shall be eligible for reappointment.

column4: (11) The Chairman, Working Director and the appointed

column3: members of the Board may be paid such remuneration out of
the fund of the Authority as the Minister may determine in
consultation  with  the  Minister  in  charge  of  the  subject  of
Finance.

column4: (12)  The  Chairman  of  the  Board  shall  preside  at  every

column3: meeting of the Board. In the absence of the Chairman at any
meeting, the members present shall elect one among their
members to preside at such meeting.

column4: (1) The quorum for a meeting of the Board shall be

column3: five members and the Board may subject to other provisions
of this Act, regulate the procedure in respect of meetings of
the Board and the transaction of business at such meetings.

column4: (2) The Chairman or the member presiding at any meeting

column3: of the Board, shall, in addition to his own vote, have a casting
vote where there is an equality of votes.
